title: CedarLane account outbound journal
content:
Topline: CedarLane Health Systems (mid-market healthcare SaaS) — strong candidate for private or dedicated Redwood deployment due to PHI, regional data policies, and bursty messaging patterns (appointment windows). Goal: land a 4-week technical pilot with Director of AI / Head of Product; convert to Dedicated contract if latency and cost look good.

Quick account snapshot:
- HQ: Minneapolis, MN; ~420 employees; product: patient engagement + teletriage for regional hospitals; estimated ARR: $18–25M.
- Tech stack: Azure (AKS), some on-prem database for patient records, EHR connectors (Epic/Cerner) via middleware.
- Security posture: HIPAA required, KMS for keys, SOC2 in progress.
- Key contacts (recon): Laura Kim (CTO), Marcus Li (Head of Product), Priya Nair (Director of AI) — Priya listed on LinkedIn as evaluating ML partners.

Use cases to pitch:
1) Patient triage chat: replace nurse triageing for low-acuity questions; measurable KPI: reduce nurse touch-time by X minutes/day.
2) Appointment reminders + two-way rescheduling: reduce no-shows by Y% (ask for current no-show baseline).
3) Post-visit follow-ups and care instructions summaries (structured outputs to push into EHR).

Constraints / red flags:
- PHI concerns: must offer Private (VPC) or Dedicated with encrypted KV + customer-managed keys.
- Latency SLOs: they need sub-200ms 95p for short chat replies in peak windows.
- Model hallucination risk when summarizing clinical guidance — will need guardrails + eval prompt sets.
- Integration work: EHR connectors require mapping and consent handling (legal).

Suggested pilot scope (4 weeks):
- Week 0: infra + legal (NDA + DPA draft) + sample data spec (de-id set)
- Week 1: deploy Redwood Private or Dedicated staging; basic routing and KMS integration
- Week 2: integrate one chat flow (triage simple Q/A), run synthetic traffic and small live cohort (2 clinics)
- Week 3: quality evals (hallucination rate, precision on triage categories), latency and cost report
- Deliverable: demo + metrics + recommendation for production sizing and pricing

Ballpark pricing signal to surface (internal talking points):
- Hosted API likely unacceptable because of PHI.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) with KMS and private subnet: estimate $Xk/month for baseline 10rps sustained (need infra team to size).
- Offer: 1-month pilot at heavily discounted reserved rate + option to convert to annual commit.

Outreach sequence (drafts):
- Cold email subject lines (short):
  * "Improve patient no-shows by automating reminders — quick pilot?"
  * "Pilot: clinical-grade patient triage with privacy controls"
- Short cold email (to Priya, 1st touch):
  "Hi Priya — noticed you’re experimenting with AI for patient engagement at CedarLane. We help platforms run production LLM inference with HIPAA controls and predictable latency. Curious whether a short 4-week pilot to evaluate triage accuracy and cost makes sense — free infra for pilot. Can I book 20 min? — Samira"
- Follow-up (voicemail + LinkedIn): 2 business days after no reply: 1-line voicemail script: "Hi Priya, Samira from Redwood — quick note about a pilot to evaluate LLM triage accuracy and HIPAA-safe deployments. Follow-up email sent. Thanks."

Discovery questions to surface during intro call:
- What are your peak messaging windows (time of day, rps)?
- Current no-show rate and triage volume per clinic / day?
- What EHR connectors do you have live? Any middleware limits?
- Who owns legal for DPA/KMS decisions?
- Is on-prem or VPC required for all PHI flows right away, or can de-id staging be used?

Metrics to capture during pilot:
- Latency (p50/p95) for short vs long replies
- Cost per 1k messages / token-level cost breakdown
- Triage category precision/recall vs nurse baseline
- Hallucination incidents per 1k responses (manual label)

Objection handling (common ones + quick rebuttals):
- "We can’t send PHI to a vendor." -> "We can run in your VPC / on-prem and integrate with your KMS. Pilot can start on de-id data to validate flows. Legal template ready for DPA."
- "LLMs hallucinate on medical facts." -> "Pilot includes domain-specific prompt templates, guardrail config, and an eval set defined with your clinical SME to measure hallucination rate; we can configure automatic fallback to nurse-hand-off on low-confidence responses."
- "Cost looks high compared to sending to rules-based bots." -> "Demonstrate unit economics: show reduced nurse time (hard cost) + conversion on follow-ups; also explore quantized model variants and batching to lower inference spend."

Prompt / eval ideas (scratch):
- Prompt: "You are a triage assistant. Ask clarifying question if needed, otherwise map to {urgent, schedule, self-care} and provide up to 2 concise next steps. If uncertain, insert: "ESCALATE_TO_NURSE""
- Eval set: 100 de-identified triage transcripts, label by nurse; measure exact-match for category + quality score 1–5 for steps.

Next actions (who does what):
- Samira: draft short pilot SOW + attach DPA template (Due: 2026-03-02)
- Ethan: pre-check infra sizing with infra-eng and produce 10rps cost estimate (Due: 2026-02-28)
- Priya: intro ask — try to get 15–20 min discovery with Marcus or Laura

Notes from prior outreach (scraps):
- Slack thread #sales-prospects: Priya liked our low-latency benchmarks (reacted with :rocket:) but asked about KMS options.
- Confluence note: CEDAR-PLATFORM-REQUIREMENTS lists HIPAA + SOC2 as must-haves.

Open questions / risks to resolve before next call:
- Will CedarLane accept a hosted staging environment with de-id data? If yes, pilot friction low. If no, need full Private install timeline and legal signoff.
- Data retention windows: they may require <24h KV cache retention — confirm.
- Does their EHR middleware allow synchronous request/response or only batch uploads?

Quick email template for pilot SOW (for internal use):
Subject: Pilot SOW — CedarLane x Redwood (4-week patient triage)
Hi Priya / Marcus / Laura,
Attached: short SOW, pilot success criteria, DPA stub. Proposed start date: 2026-03-10. Offer: no infra charge for pilot.

Mental checklist before demo:
- Bring latency benchmarks for similar customers
- Short walkthrough of Private deployment and KMS flow (diagram)
- Triage demo + clear fallback handling example
- Be ready to discuss model variants (quantized 8-bit vs fp16) and cost tradeoffs

End-of-file notes: keep this doc informal — capture call timestamps and snippets here. If we get to SOW, move final text to Confluence and attach signed DPA.
